integrity: The displayed proof covers all real angle gaps in the stated domain. A standalone standard-library checker provides finite independent-coordinate consistency tests. Independent scientific audit and external validation have not occurred.
limitations: Planar regular starting polygons, common centered incircle, rotation-only intersections, fixed n and number k of copies. The exact quadratic deficit is local for fixed n,k. Alternative prior formulations or unindexed literature remain possible.
source_date_note: The date is the verified first online public release of the earliest motivating cited paper, not a publication date for this mathematical finding.
title: Strict angular-gap majorization of Mahler products for rotational polygon intersections
